title: Chapter 1333 - 15: A Good Night’S Sleep
content:
Chapter 1333 - 15: A Good Night’S Sleep

Chapter 1333: Chapter 15: A Good Night’s Sleep

Luo Hou looked at Lin Yuan, a hint of trance in his expression.

Before becoming a time lifeform, when he saw Lin Yuan in action, a feeling of being unable to resist arose in his heart.

Now having become a time lifeform, facing the Great Saint of the Galaxy, he still felt an unsurpassable sense of inadequacy.

"Please sit."

Lin Yuan waved his hand, and the surroundings changed.

He brought Luo Hou to a beautifully scenic estate.

"Alright..."

Luo Hou couldn’t help but be anxious.

At this moment, he didn’t even know whether it was he who had ascended to the Thirteenth Layer, or the Great Saint of the Galaxy before him.

"How does it feel to be a time lifeform?"

Lin Yuan smiled as he looked at Luo Hou.

Towards this newly promoted Thirteenth Layer, Lin Yuan was still quite friendly.

Primarily because through observing future timelines, Lin Yuan saw that the other party bore no hostility towards him.

This time, Luo Hou wasn’t here to seek revenge or anything.

He merely wanted to meet Lin Yuan.

If Lin Yuan chose to conceal his strength and disguise himself as a normal Invincible Great Saint,

Luo Hou might even bestow some opportunities as gratitude.

This was the conclusion drawn from numerous observed timelines by Lin Yuan.

However, at Lin Yuan’s current level, the gifts from a newly advanced time lifeform were of no concern to him.

Luo Hou, newly entered the Thirteenth Layer, was penniless, and his resources were far inferior to Lin Yuan’s.

Upon hearing Lin Yuan’s inquiry, Luo Hou originally wanted to answer ’great’.

It was indeed great.

After ascending to the Thirteenth Layer, Luo Hou felt everything had changed.

It was as if he had ascended from two dimensions to three, lifeforms at the Twelfth Layer and below appeared as fragile as paper.

But thinking of the unfathomable depth of the Great Saint of the Galaxy before him, the words ’great’ turned into ’not bad’ at the last moment.

"The essence of life has just transformed to the Thirteenth Layer, you need to seclude yourself to adapt, it’s best not to fully attempt observing future timelines." Lin Yuan looked at Luo Hou with a teasing smile.

At this moment, Luo Hou was trying his best to observe Lin Yuan’s future timeline.

This is also akin to a fearless rookie, a slightly more experienced time lifeform would realize what it means if a being’s timeline is too blurred to be observed.

Who would dare to continue peeping?

"Yes."

Luo Hou was startled inside, also feeling that he was somewhat impulsive.

He promptly ceased observing Lin Yuan’s timeline.

"What time loop did you encounter?"

Lin Yuan casually asked as he looked at Luo Hou.

The formation of time loops originates from the supreme rules of endless dimensional planes.

Beyond the observation of timelines, even Thirteenth Layer time lifeforms and Time Lords cannot spy on them.

Besides the one who experienced it, outsiders wouldn’t know.

Earlier, during a conversation with seven time lifeforms from the Chaos Void, Lin Yuan learned the specific test of the time loop they experienced.

Now that Luo Hou had just broken through the time loop, Lin Yuan was curious about what Luo Hou experienced in the time loop and what the test was.

Each time loop faced by a Twelfth Layer perfection is different, completely targeting their weaknesses.

"The time loop I fell into..."

Luo Hou’s thoughts scattered, speaking in a slightly grave tone: "In the time loop, I became a beggar, living in an era of chaos, unable to use any supernormal powers, even the speed of thought was restricted to mundane levels. Besides having complete memories, there was no difference from an ordinary person."

Luo Hou’s expression revealed a trace of lingering fear.

This differs from reincarnation, where although powers are lost, the rules one grasps remain. Even though still a mortal, one can leverage rules to exert unimaginable strength.

Within a time loop, unable to use any supernormal power truly means unable to use any supernormal power, to the extent of being unable to sense the fluctuations of any rule path.

Furthermore, there was one hidden premise.

That premise was lifespan.

Without the augmentation of supernormal powers, a mundane lifespan is just a few decades.

In a turbulent era, living past thirty was considered long-lived.

"What was the test?"

Lin Yuan asked.

"To end the chaos and establish a unified empire." Luo Hou said: "I was merely a beggar, without backing, unable to wield any strength, even on the verge of starving to death, yet I was required to end the chaotic era and establish a unified empire?"

"Indeed very challenging, and also very targeted."

Lin Yuan nodded.

He had seen Luo Hou’s past timelines, understanding that this newly promoted time lifeform spent long years immersed in cultivation, uninterested in external affairs. As for recruiting troops? Gathering followers? It was something he had never done, nor considered.

Under the premise of a mundane lifespan of mere decades, if Luo Hou didn’t pass the test before his lifespan ended, he would have his memory of this loop erased and start anew.

Normally, if one can’t pass the test in the first loop, they won’t be able to pass it in subsequent loops.

Luo Hou’s greatest strength was cultivation. He was willing to endure countless torments for the sake of training in that Thirteenth Layer inheritance.

But in the time loop, there was no test of his cultivation, but rather a test in an area he had never engaged with.

"How did you finally pass the test?"

Lin Yuan continued to ask.

"I spent fifty years, going through countless hardships, surviving one life-and-death crisis after another, and finally unified half the land, about to have a decisive battle with my great enemy. As long as I won, I could pass the test and establish a unified empire."

Luo Hou said.

"Did you win?" Lin Yuan looked at Luo Hou.

"No, I didn’t win." Luo Hou shook his head, "In that final decisive battle, I lost miserably, all my important followers died, and even I was captured alive."
